name: VO2 hill 5x3 trained 47
description: Five 3 min climbs at 11.0 km/h, level 7 (about 10 percent): VO2max work on a steep grade. Needs --running-mode, handrail up. See docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog, building gently. Last minutes just under the first rep pace.

steps.name: Climb 3 min
steps.notes: RPE 8-9: hard but controlled; the last rep matches the first.

steps.name: Recover
steps.notes: Easy jog or walk; let the breathing drop.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Jog then walk until the breathing is calm.
